name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-word-editor
description: A personal Word (.docx) quick-editing plugin: exposes open/read/find/str_replace/add_to/delete/formula_scan/formula_convert/save model tools so the caller agent opens a source (or template copy), edits through in-session target ids (pure OOXML with a style whitelist, row-clone table inserts, and atomic save), converts cleaned-up linear math to native Word OMath via Windows Word COM automation, and saves a new file next to the source with a clickable local link. A formula-cleanup subagent normalizes ambiguous LaTeX candidates when formula_scan requests it; the source is never overwritten.
